summary: Phase T regression smoke test (backend + frontend) via public preview URL. All 8 backend endpoints pass; frontend loads with correct title, admin login via UI works and safety-status-light (level=ok) appears after login. No critical JS console errors.

minor.issue: Occasional cold-start 502/timeout on first hit; retry helper in test smooths this over (no code fix required).

critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/smoke_regression_test.py hits public URL; retries mask flaky ingress cold starts – acceptable for regression smoke.

SafetyLight (Header.js:14) intentionally renders only when /api/safety/status returns 200 (requires admin auth); pre-login the light is hidden. This is by design but may confuse users expecting an always-visible indicator.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smoke suite lives at backend/tests/smoke_regression_test.py. Run: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/smoke_regression_test.py -o addopts='' -v. Only read-only endpoints + login are exercised – safe to re-run. Frontend flow: click [data-testid=admin-lock-button] -> fill admin-username + admin-password -> submit; then safety-status-light appears with data-level. External preview URL occasionally cold-starts with 502; helper retries 3x with 2s backoff.
rca of the issue: n/a – no production bug found. Initial two false-positives (health 502, safety_status 401) were caused by (a) cold-start ingress and (b) missing auth header in test; both resolved with retry helper + admin token.
